== Ingredients ==
* 500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (18 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]/1½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) minced [[Cookbook:Veal|veal]] meat
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]]
* ¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* 1 clove of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* 125 g (4 oz/¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]
* 30 g (1 oz/1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]]) grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]] for frying

== Procedure ==
# Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Using your hands, squeeze all ingredients.
# Heat a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium heat and drizzle on a little olive oil. Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 175°C (350°F) in the meantime.
# Use your hands to roll meat into bite sized balls.
# Place the meatballs in the skillet and cook uncovered for 3 minutes, then roll them over and cook another 3 minutes.
# Transfer the meatballs onto a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] in the oven for 20–25 minutes.
